proof_0338.moves: A definitional-unfolding simp lemma: the ring equivalence built for an empty variable type computes, on application, to the stated formula (the constant/coefficient extraction) by rfl. All the algebraic-structure names are instance bookkeeping carried in the statement, not steps.

proof_0339.moves: Given a faithfully flat ring hom, the previously-established result gives that the opposite morphism is a regular epi; then the general categorical equivalence 'regular epi iff effective epi' is applied in the forward direction. Two named results chained by Iff.mp.

proof_0340.moves: Take the already-proved equivalence 'coercion of an extended-nonneg-real equals 1 iff the original equals 1' and negate both sides. The entire proof is the contrapositive/negation of an existing iff.

proof_0342.moves: A negation about the empty list: unfolding the predicate on nil yields the 'zero' sign rather than 'pos', and the constructors are distinct, so the claim is false-by-computation. The proof is decision-procedure/simp residue — no mathematical idea, just constructor disjointness.

proof_0343.moves: Evaluate the determinant of the explicit small integer G2 Cartan matrix by kernel computation (decide). The content is 'unfold the matrix, compute the determinant, it comes out to the stated value' — no lemma is really invoked.

proof_0344.moves: The zero element of the space of points is defined to be the zero power series (as a subtype element), so the asserted value of its underlying data holds by rfl. Purely definitional.

proof_0345.moves: Rewrite the goal using the order-reversal property of the involution sigma (x <= y iff sigma y <= sigma x) and then the involutivity sigma(sigma x) = x; the two sides become literally the same statement. The glue (Eq.mpr/propext/congrArg) is rewriting residue.

proof_0346.moves: Holder conjugacy is the Holder-triple condition with third entry 1, so the general 'push a Holder triple through the toNNReal map' result applies; one then rewrites toNNReal 1 = 1 to put the conclusion in conjugate form.

proof_0347.moves: Unfold strict monotonicity on the family of finite sets to 'strict inclusion implies strictly smaller extended cardinality', introduce the two sets and the strict-inclusion hypothesis, and apply the existing comparison lemma. The only non-bookkeeping step is that one citation.

proof_0348.moves: Rewrite rank as the supremum over linearly independent subsets of their cardinalities, then bound the supremum termwise: each such subset injects into the module, so its cardinal is at most that of the whole module. Rewrite-then-bound-the-sup is the whole argument.

proof_0349.moves: Definitional: the inverse of the homeomorphism identifying X with the product against a one-point-type sends x to the pair whose second coordinate is x, so the stated second component holds by rfl.

proof_0350.moves: Definitional projection lemma: the object part of the extend-scalars pseudofunctor is by construction the stated module category, so unfolding the tower of pseudofunctor/prefunctor projections gives rfl. No mathematical step at all.

proof_0351.moves: Complete normality is characterized by 'every subspace (with the subspace topology) is normal'; the proof just feeds the given hypothesis into the reverse direction of that characterization.

proof_0352.moves: The constant polynomial 1 is C 1, so the Taylor shift fixes it: the proof is the constant-polynomial case of the Taylor lemma, with the numeral 1 identified definitionally with C 1 through the One/OfNat instance tower.

proof_0353.moves: A homeomorphism is in particular a closed embedding, so the already-proved stability of compact multiplicative support under precomposition with a closed embedding applies directly. Two citations, no other content.

proof_0354.moves: The pointwise subtraction of finsets is by definition the image of the binary operation, so the claim is exactly the general image2-versus-intersection inclusion; the proof is one citation after unfolding vsub.

proof_0355.moves: Wrapper lemma: extract the well-formedness proof of the underlying implementation tree from the Raw well-formedness hypothesis and hand it, with the transitivity-of-compare instance, to the corresponding internal Impl lemma. proof_0356.moves: Definitional: the inverse of the 'raise to a power coprime to the group order' bijection is defined as raising to the corresponding power, so the applied form holds by rfl.

proof_0357.moves: Contrapositive: if the two boxes were equal their underlying sets would be equal, but a set disjoint from itself is empty while a box's underlying set is nonempty. So combine 'disjointness forces distinctness of nonempty sets' with injectivity of the coercion.

proof_0358.moves: Continuity into the units group is checked coordinatewise: the underlying-value map and the inverse map must both be continuous. Compose the given continuous monoid hom with the continuous coercions (value and inverse of a unit) and assemble the pair through the characterization.

proof_0359.moves: A repackaged form of primitive recursion: apply the existing nat_rec result and then feed it the right arguments by composing with the identity and the pairing, i.e. rearranging the argument tuple via the binary-composition lemma.

proof_0360.moves: Building a unit-valued map from a list is by definition inserting-if-new the keys into the empty map, so the claim reduces to the internal lemma about getKey! after such insertions, using the pairwise-distinctness of the keys under the comparison and transitivity of compare.
